product.name: 5 way 450mm Underground Drainage Base for Inspection Chamber Set Circular Base for Manhole system Base only
product.description:
The Polydrain MB450 chamber base is a versatile and durable foundation for 450mm inspection chambers, designed specifically for use with 110mm underground drainage systems. Manufactured from tough polypropylene, the MB450 combines strength with lightweight handling, making installation quick and efficient on site.
With a diameter of 450mm and a height of 236mm, the MB450 base provides ample capacity for shallow chamber construction. It features multiple 110mm inlet and outlet positions, supplied with blanking plugs to seal unused connections, giving installers flexibility to adapt layouts to project requirements.
Fully compliant with BS EN 13598-1 and Building Regulations Part H1, the MB450 is suitable for inspection chambers up to 1.2m deep in non-adoptable applications. In Wales, it conforms to SfA7 Type 4 chamber detail, ensuring regional compliance.
The MB450 is compatible with Polydrain risers and a choice of round or square access covers, allowing chambers to be tailored to site conditions and finished neatly at ground level. Its ribbed design ensures stability, while the supplied blanking plugs maintain system integrity.
Trusted by contractors and merchants alike, the Polydrain MB450 chamber base delivers a reliable, regulation-compliant solution for modern drainage systems, balancing ease of installation with long-term performance.

product.name: Decoupling Membrane 3mm 15m Anti Crack Waterproof Tile Mat Underfloor Heating Vapour Barrier Sound Proof Wet Room Bathroom Kitchen
product.description:
Protect your tiled floors from cracking, movement and moisture damage with this professional-grade 3mm Decoupling Membrane — the essential undertile installation layer trusted by professional tilers and DIY enthusiasts across the UK for ceramic, stone and all standard floor tile installations.
This 3 layer polyethylene composite decoupling membrane is specifically engineered to prevent the transmission of lateral stresses and substrate movement to the finished tiled surface — eliminating the cracking, grouting failure and tile debonding commonly seen when tiling over problematic substrates such as heated screeds, timber floors, OSB, plywood and tongue and groove floorboards that are subject to natural movement.
The membrane channels provide even heat distribution throughout the floor when used in combination with wet or electric underfloor heating systems — eliminating hot and cold spots and ensuring your underfloor heating performs at maximum efficiency without raising the sub-floor level significantly.
Fully waterproof and ideal for wet rooms, bathrooms and kitchens — the polyethylene composite construction protects the substrate from water infiltration preventing damp damage to timber floors and structural substrates below the tile. The integrated vapour barrier provides additional moisture protection whilst the acoustic properties reduce impact sound transmission through the tiled floor.
Simply roll out the membrane, secure it to the substrate and apply your tile adhesive directly to the membrane surface. Compatible with all standard tile adhesives and suitable for use under ceramic, porcelain, stone and all standard floor tiles on concrete, timber, OSB and heated screed substrates.
Supplied as a 15 metre roll at 1 metre width — covering 15 square meters per roll.

product.name: MDPE TEE Compression Pipe Fittings-Comprehensive  25mm - 1/2" BSPF - 25mm
product.description:
This MDPE Tee Compression Pipe Fitting is crafted from high-quality medium-density polyethylene (MDPE), a material widely used for its exceptional durability, chemical resistance, and flexibility. Designed to facilitate branch connections at 90 degrees, the fitting supports a wide range of applications such as domestic water mains, agricultural irrigation, and industrial systems.

The compression fitting uses a threaded locking mechanism to ensure a secure and leak-resistant connection without the need for specialist tools. Rated to handle pressure up to PN10 (10 bar), this fitting performs reliably in demanding conditions, including buried pipelines and outdoor installations.

MDPE’s natural resistance to corrosion from chemicals and aggressive substances ensures minimal maintenance and a long lifespan. Whether you're laying new water infrastructure or upgrading an existing system, this tee fitting provides strength, efficiency, and peace of mind.

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Water Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 7m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Water Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground water pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant plastic mesh, it features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed warning text. The highly visible mesh helps identify buried water pipe routes when exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, it provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams, helping to identify underground services during construction and groundworks. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground water pipe routes before or during excavation. Its durable, rot-resistant construction is designed to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for service identification. Suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers, this detectable warning mesh provides a practical way to mark buried water pipes and improve visibility of underground services. Certified to EN 12613. PLEASE NOTE - Images are for illustrative purposes only.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Blue - 300mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner and outer layer and reinforced with 3 or 4 plies of polyester braid, these couplers deliver exceptional strength, flexibility, and reliability. Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Rated for continuous use at high temperatures and withstanding working pressures of up to 10 Bar (depending on size), they’re ideal for custom builds, replacements, or performance upgrades. Each hose is precision-moulded to ensure a secure fit and optimal flow. Built to SAEJ20 industry standards and compatible with most fluids, these couplers are trusted by professionals for motorsport, marine, automotive, and manufacturing use. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Thermopanel Centre Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former - 1200 x 1200 x 20mm - Gold Sunburst Grate Design and Tanking Kit
product.description: Thermopanel Centre Square Drain Wet Room Shower Tray Former (20/25mm)  The Thermopanel Square Centre Drain Shower Tray Former is the perfect solution for creating a stylish, flush walk-in shower or wet room. Unlike bulky acrylic trays, it provides a seamless, tile-ready base that integrates beautifully with your bathroom floor. Lightweight but exceptionally strong, the tray includes a pre-formed 2% gradient for efficient drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer, ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, stone, or mosaics.  Available in both 20mm and 25mm depths, this versatile tray can be trimmed by up to 50mm from each edge (equal cuts required), giving installers complete flexibility. It comes with a centre-positioned square drain, with a choice of six grate designs – Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial – and three finishes: Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel. The Thermopanel system is suitable for timber or concrete floors, works seamlessly with electric underfloor heating, and is supported by a lifetime warranty when fitted according to the manufacturer’s instructions.  Key Features:  20mm or 25mm depth options. Square centre drain with 6 grate designs (Leaf, Tile, Square, Sunburst, Spiral or Radial). Choice of finishes: Black, Gold, Stainless Steel. Waste included. Pre-made 2% fall ensures fast water flow. Tile-ready surface, suitable for ceramic, porcelain, mosaics & natural stone. Lightweight, strong, and easy to install. Trim up to 50mm from each edge for flexibility. Compatible with electric underfloor heating. Suitable for timber and concrete floors. Backed by a 25 year warranty.

product.name: Hoses UK 25mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 1m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear corrugated PVC hose is designed for medium-duty environments requiring a crush-resistant, UV-stable, and easy-to-handle flexible hose. Operating from -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C) and compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this corrugated PVC hose provides reliability, resilience, and ease of use in a variety of light to medium-duty environments. Key features include a smooth bore for consistent water or fluid flow, a flexible corrugated exterior for efficient fluid transfer, and a tough plastic rib reinforcement that resists crushing and maintains flow integrity under mechanical stress. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

Simply insert the pipe into the socket until it reaches the seal for a secure, leak-free connection.
Suitable for connecting to standard 110mm push-fit or plain-ended pipework throughout your drainage system.

Simple to install with standard fixings, these clips are suitable for both new installations and repairs on existing 110mm drainage systems.

product.name: 110mm black solvent DS Elbow (92.5 degree) bend

Suitable for connecting to standard 110mm solvent weld pipework and fittings throughout your drainage system.

product.name: Aveli Raised 1000 x 1000mm Quadrant Shower Tray with Brushed Brass Waste
product.description:
The Aveli Raised 1000 x 1000mm quadrant shower tray is designed for use with shower enclosures, offering a practical solution where floor construction prevents flush installation. In the box, you will find a white acrylic capped ABS quadrant tray, support legs, matching side panels for a concealed finish, and a high-flow waste finished in brushed brass. The tray measures 1000mm on both sides, stands 140mm high, and its raised design allows installation above concrete or difficult floors, providing a 95mm void for pipework and the included 90mm waste. Aveli shower trays are compatible with all major brands of enclosure glass, making this tray highly flexible for renovation or new-build projects. Installation guidance recommends ensuring the tray is fully supported on all legs with side panels fitted after all waste pipework is connected. The tray can be trimmed to fit irregular spaces, though any cut edge should be properly sealed to protect against water ingress. Approved to WRAS and BS EN 14527 standards and carrying a 25-year warranty, this tray offers long-term performance and peace of mind.

product.name: Ibc s60x6 Tank Extender Kit For 20mm Straight Mdpe Water Pipe
product.description: IBC Tank Linking Kit with Outlet Extender – 2" S60x6 Coarse Thread Product Description: This high-quality IBC tank linking kit is designed for tanks featuring a 2" S60x6 coarse threaded outlet. IBC tanks (Intermediate Bulk Containers) are large, reusable storage units used for holding and transporting liquids such as water, chemicals, or food products. Built with a strong metal frame and a recessed outlet valve, they are perfect for a wide range of applications—from rainwater harvesting and irrigation to industrial fluid storage. However, the recessed outlet can make connecting taps or pipe fittings awkward and time-consuming. That’s where this extender kit comes in. The included outlet extender brings the thread clear of the tank’s frame, making it quick and easy to attach fittings or link multiple tanks together. This kit includes MDPE (Medium-Density Polyethylene) water pipe fittings, allowing you to create a secure and watertight connection between tanks or between a tank and your plumbing setup. Available Fitting Options: Sizes: 20mm, 25mm, or 32mm Types: Elbow, Tee, or Straight connection Optional Flow Control Valve for easy regulation of water flow Typical Uses: Linking multiple IBC tanks for increased water storage capacity Connecting tanks to irrigation or garden watering systems Rainwater harvesting setups Industrial and agricultural water management Key Features & Benefits: Extends the recessed IBC outlet for easy access and connection Compatible with standard 2" S60x6 coarse thread outlets Durable, watertight fittings suitable for long-term outdoor use Multiple fitting sizes and styles to suit your setup Optional flow control valve for convenient operation Simplify your IBC tank setup with this all-in-one linking kit—making tank connection, water transfer, and system management effortless.

product.name: 38mm to 45mm (1 1/2" To 1 3/4") Plastic Hose Connector White Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: ProWarm 100W Premium Electric Underfloor Heating Mat (for Tile/Stone/Laminate/Wood) - 25m²
product.description:
Take the chill off tile, stone, laminate and engineered wood floors with ProWarm electrical underfloor heating. Designed for bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces, the pre-spaced mesh mat provides discreet, even warmth and can supplement or replace radiators when sized for room heat loss. Insulation and thermostat control help direct heat upwards and limit wasted energy. Roll out the mat, cut the mesh only to turn it, then spread flexible tile adhesive or pour self-levelling compound over the cable. Never cut the heating cable or fit it beneath fixed furniture. A 4 metre cold tail aids routing. A qualified electrician must connect the system. The cable has a lifetime manufacturer's warranty.

Choose from three wattages: 
100W for new-builds or secondary heating in older homes.
150W for primary heating in bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.
200W for faster warm-up times and high heat loss areas.
